title: Page draft and publish

story.need: create and revise a block-based page without changing the live site
story.outcome: review a draft and deliberately publish an immutable revision

scope: Create a page draft with title, slug, description, and typed blocks
Update a draft using optimistic concurrency
Preview and publish the current draft
Expose equivalent application commands to the admin UI and MCP
dataRequirements: A page owns immutable numbered revisions
Draft and published pointers are independent
Every revision records actor and timestamp
Blocks have stable identifiers, type names, versions, and validated data
permissions: An authenticated editor may create and update drafts
An authenticated publisher may publish a draft
The MVP site owner holds both permissions

acceptanceCriteria.given: a published page and an authenticated editor
acceptanceCriteria.when: the editor saves a changed draft
then: the preview displays the new draft

acceptanceCriteria.given: a draft loaded at revision sequence N
acceptanceCriteria.when: another update has already created sequence N+1
then: the current draft is not overwritten
the live page points at that immutable revision

acceptanceCriteria.when: they update the same draft value
then: both create the same revision shape

fixtures: published page with a newer draft
